summary: Iter 39 — Manager role + WhatsApp approval workflow. Backend pytest 14 passed / 3 skipped (only skips are staff regression checks — staff login is failing on the platform but is unrelated to this feature). Frontend UI verified end-to-end via Playwright: manager login lands on /dashboard, sidebar shows exactly the 6 allowed items (Dashboard, Appointments, CRM, Services, POS/Billing, Reviews) with none of the 10 restricted items leaking; all 10 restricted deep-links (/reports /settings /plans /staff /inventory /gallery /assistant /messages /attendance /refer) redirect to /dashboard via OwnerOnly wrapper; manager does NOT see the wa-approvals-widget; manager clicking confirm-appt-<id> does NOT open a wa.me popup (verified via popup event listener with 3s timeout — no popup fired) and the appointment status transitions to CONFIRMED. Admin login lands on /dashboard with wa-approvals-widget visible (copy: 'X messages from your manager awaiting approval'). Manager creating a request via /api/whatsapp-requests returned 200 and it immediately appeared in the widget after refresh. Admin clicking Approve & Send removed the request from the pending list; admin clicking Reject also removed the request. Backend contract confirmed: manager PUT /api/appointments/{id}/status confirmed returns {wa_request_created: true, whatsapp_url: null}, admin returns {whatsapp_url: 'https://wa.me/...', wa_request_created: false}. Approve returns {ok:true, wa_url:'https://wa.me/<phone>?text=<encoded>'}.

minor.issue: Manager Dashboard page triggers ~20 console 403s per page load because Dashboard.jsx fetches admin-only endpoints (/api/reports/sales, staff-performance, etc.) that the manager role is denied. Feature still works but the noise is wasteful and clutters devtools. Consider role-gating those fetches in Dashboard.jsx OR relaxing them to require_admin (Charts still render since /reports/dashboard is allowed).

issues: Chart width/height warnings (-1) fired by Recharts container — pre-existing, not caused by this feature.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:290 require_admin now permits role in {admin, super_admin, manager} — correct for widening customer/service/appointment read+write to managers.

server.py:401 require_tenant_admin still strictly excludes manager (only admin/super_admin) — this is what enforces the 403 on /reports/sales, /reports/daily, /reports/staff-commission, and /whatsapp-requests list/approve/reject. Good defence-in-depth.

server.py:2072-2082 manager branch in update_appt_status: writes to db.whatsapp_requests without setting tenant_id on the document. The requirement statement says 'whatsapp_requests collection is tenant-scoped'. However neither the direct POST /whatsapp-requests handler nor the auto-insert here writes a tenant_id field, and list_whatsapp_requests queries {status:'pending'} with no tenant filter. If more than one tenant is ever seeded, admin of tenant A would see manager-of-tenant-B's pending requests. Recommend adding tenant_id filter + storing tenant_id on each doc.
server.py:1462 create_whatsapp_request: same missing tenant_id field on insert.
server.py:1466/1471/1476/1489 list/count/approve/reject all miss tenant scoping — potential cross-tenant leak once >1 tenant exists.
Frontend WhatsAppApprovals.jsx polls every 30s (setInterval) — fine, but no cleanup guard against overlapping requests if the API is slow; acceptable at this scale.

Frontend Appointments.jsx uses isManager check to gate WA send in sendReminder / sendReviewLink / setStatus — correct pattern; backend still enforces via server-side role check on update_appt_status so client tampering wouldn't bypass approval.
OwnerOnly wrapper in App.js correctly redirects manager to /dashboard for the 10 restricted routes — verified via Playwright.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (manager sidebar + 10 deep-link redirects + widget hidden + confirm-no-popup + admin widget + approve + reject)
